text: You raise prices because of a tariff, the government gives the money back, and we count it as compensation. That is just bookkeeping with a title.
name: Doris Hale

text: They said they couldn't afford us, then found a hundred-six million somewhere. I checked under the couch cushions. Nothing.
name: Mel Ferrante

text: A company that keeps helping people who can't pay enough is a charity that got a stock ticker by mistake.
name: Janet Okafor
